entities.summary: Daria Serhiivna Snigur is a Ukrainian professional tennis player. She has a career-high WTA ranking of world No. 93 in singles, achieved on 30 March 2026. Snigur has won 11 singles titles at tournaments of the ITF Women's Circuit.
